prompt: Build a modular Web Application Firewall (WAF) in C# structured as: (1) HTTP Request Inspector parsing headers, query strings, and body payloads for SQL injection signatures, (2) Rate Limiting and IP Reputation Engine tracking sliding window request counts per client IP, and (3) Incident Response Subsystem logging violations and triggering automated firewall block rules.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Inspector Score: 0-5 (Evaluates robust payload parsing and regex injection detection)
Module 2 Ratelimit Score: 0-5 (Evaluates thread-safe token bucket or sliding window tracking)
Module 3 Response Score: 0-5 (Evaluates audit logging and blocklist management)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates middleware interception pipeline efficiency)
